cho 'phrul gar dgu'i rol pa brjid/ khrag 'thung khro rgyal padma he ru ka /gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar chod sol// byin gyis rlobs shig mchog thun dngos grub stsol// mon kha spa gro stag tshang seng phug tu// mi bzad khro bo 'chol ba'i skur bstan tshe// zab don zhus pa mkhar chen bza' mtsho rgyal// lha yi sras mchog rgyal sras khu dbon la// gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar chod sol// byin gyis rlobs shig mchog thun dngos grub stsol// rgya chen gu ru'i bka' dang zab mo'i gter// sdud mdzad ārya sa le sprul pa'i sku /bsam bzhin zab gter mchog gi bdag po ru// legs byon rgyal ba kun dngos stag sham par// gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar chod sol// byin gyis rlobs shig mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ kha rag mgo dgu'i bdud mtsho'i klong dkyil nas// skal ldan skyes bu'i khrom chen 'dus pa'i dbus// rdzu 'phrul nus pas shog ser mngon sum blangs// gnas dang gang zag gter ston sprul sku la// gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar chod sol// byin gyis rlobs shig mchog thun dngos grub stsol// byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas mchog dam pa ru// gu ru'i lung bstan ji bzhin bstan pa spel// skye rgyud rigs sbyangs smon lam las 'phro sad// chos bdag grub pa'i skyes chen mchog rnams la// gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar chod sol// byin gyis rlobs shig mchog thun dngos grub stsol// ye shes sems dpa' padma thod phreng rtsal// gdug pa 'dul phyir dbang drag rol pa'i gar// sku gsung thugs sprul phrin las khro chen bzhi// ye shes ḍā ki sde bzhi ging chen rtsal// gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar chod sol// byin gyis rlobs shig mchog thun dngos grub stsol// lhan skyes ye shes dwangs ma'i srog zhabs su// tshud pa'i dam las mi 'da' mi g.yel 'khor// zab mo'i gter dang de 'dzin srung skyob brtson// gter srung dam can srung ma rgya mtsho la// gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar chod sol// byin gyis rlobs shig mchog thun dngos grub stsol// snod bcud thams cad khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor du// ye nas yin pa gsal phyir bskyed rim dang*// de nyid ye shes rol par shar ba yis// zung 'jug mchog gi rnal 'byor mtshan ldan shog

/srung ba'i go cha mi phig btsan pa'i rdzong*// zlog pa'i 'khrul 'khor phas kyi rgol ba 'joms// bsad pa'i mtshon gyis gnod byed rtsad nas gcod// las gsum phrin las tshul bzhin 'grub par shog /dgra bgegs mthar byed khar btsud ldang med mnan// drag po hom gyis gzugs phung gzhob thul bsreg /bzod dka'i thun zor 'phangs pas dmigs med dag /mnan bsreg 'phang ba'i las rab byang chub shog /nyon mongs rang mdangs rgyal bsen dam sri'i tshogs// gnad dbab shi sa bstan dang ar la gtad// bka' dang dam tshud phrin las thogs med sgrub// dbang drag 'bar ba'i mthu stobs kun ldan shog /ngo bo don gyi lha gcig drag po rtsal// zab pa'i yang snying 'bru gcig hūm̐ gi chos// gnas lugs rang ngo rig pa don tig gi /gcig chog lam gyis bdag gzhan grol gyur cig /

ma hā gu ru drag po rtsal gyi brgyud 'debs 'di ni/ bdag gzhan gyi thun dang po'i nyams len du chos rje gling pas rang byung 'khor lo sdom pa'i lhan skyes kyi zhol/ lho tsandan nags ma'i tshal rma bya gzhon nu gar byed pa'i gling stod dben pa'i bsti gnas bde chen du sbyar ba'o/// /
